narr: Strong to severe storms developed during the early morning hours and produced up to half dollar sized hail over southwest Missouri as a southward moving front passed through the region. The front stalled near the Arkansas state border during the morning and afternoon and leading to several rounds of thunderstorms and isolated flash flooding.
